mira: Quick heads-upI opened a short handbook PR adding a tenant-onboarding example (labeling + reserve flow), a tiny SDK snippet, and tightened SLA wording. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4401
ben: Nice. Can we avoid 'complete isolation' phrasing? Ops prefers precise language around reserved vs burst.
priya: Agreed. Proposed line: 'Reserved pools provide isolation for compute and eviction behavior; burst pools remain best-effort under oversubscription.' Also adding this Python example showing model_version pinning:
```python
from redwood import DedicatedClient
client = DedicatedClient(api_key="${REDWOOD_API_KEY}")
client.provision_tenant(tenant_id="team-orbit", model_version="ggml-13b@2025-02-01", reserved_gpu_count=2, isolation_level="reserved")
```
docs-bot: CI started for PR #4401 (lint, link-check, snippet-validate).
eli: Link-check failed 1 anchor moved in autoscale doc. point to docs/autoscale#policy-schemas and add a short migration note for legacy 'burst_pool' -> 'reserved_pool' naming.
mira: pushed link fix and the migration note. Also reworded SLA to: 'SLA failures are measured by request rejections and sustained latency beyond configured SLOs; short-lived queues (<5s) are considered degraded performance.'
priya: added a tiny unit test in docs to validate anchors exist to catch future renames.
docs-bot: CI passed all checks green.
ben: LGTM. approving.
mira: merged and tagged #release-notes. Thanks everyone for quick reviews.
